people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
translations.bsb: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
translations.kjv: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
